result:
I reviewed INC-1 and it does not meet DoD-I. Four High findings are open, so the next session is `/fix F-01`. I committed the review report (`docs/04_review-INC-1.md`) and the updated handover (`docs/00_progress.md`); the unrelated log files in the working tree are not committed.

I read the security-relevant backend code, compared the groups and contacts screens with their wireframes, and ran the frozen E2E tests and the 320/768/1280 px responsive spec in Chromium. 8 passed and 6 failed. I did not read every controller or component, and I did not re-take screenshots of every screen at every width.

| F | Severity | Finding |
|---|---|---|
| F-01 | High | Creating a contact shows no "The contact was saved." message; only editing does. E2E-01 and E2E-03 fail at that step. The spec doesn't name the text, so the fix session has to decide whether the app or the frozen test is wrong. |
| F-02 | High | At 320 px six screens scroll horizontally: groups, contacts, filter, members, history and Trash. The groups screen uses a table where WF-05 shows cards. |
| F-03 | High | E2E-02 fails because `getByLabel('Role')` matches the members table's "Role of {name}" labels. |
| F-04 | High | E2E-08 can't find the "Group not found" heading, and E2E-03 and E2E-06 time out on the "Group" navigation. I haven't analysed the cause yet. |
| F-05 | Medium | WebKit has a Tab stop with no visible focus. |
| F-06 | Medium | `feat` commits 5a01e68 and 6d4c79b (the T-27 and T-20 UI tasks) have no `Red:` lines. |
| F-07 | Medium | 24 commit subjects exceed 72 characters, and 18 `feat` commits exceed the 15-file or 400-line limit. History can't be rewritten, so this goes to the release notes. |
| F-08 | Medium | Cleanup of old `deleted_accounts` rows is still open (ADR-08), and the browser tests AC-016-02, 05 and 06 have not been run. |
| F-09 | Medium | JaCoCo report generation fails in the Docker run. |
| F-10 | Low | At 320 px the contacts screen puts the Filter button below the search box; WF-08 has it on the search row. |

On the code I read, authorisation, trusted-side validation, parameterised queries, formula-safe export cells, security headers and log content all look sound, and I found nothing from INC-2 built early.

D-48 says the next step is `/fix`, not `/implement`, so I set the handover command to `/fix F-01`. D-48 also says to check each failing E2E for a test defect first and bring any test change to you as a decision.
